problem_statement.name: Problem Statement
problem_statement.description: Clarity, real-world relevance, scope definition, and target audience alignment of the problem being solved.

solution_quality.name: Solution Quality
solution_quality.description: Soundness of technical architecture, system design, domain modeling, and appropriateness of tech stack.

code_quality.name: Code Quality
code_quality.description: Deterministic syntax conformance, formatting consistency, AST complexity, and static analysis health.

optimization.name: Optimization
optimization.description: Resource efficiency, memory management, bundle size awareness, and algorithmic complexity.

ui_ux.name: UI/UX
ui_ux.description: Visual polish, responsive viewports, design system consistency, keyboard accessibility, and state feedback.

performance.name: Performance
performance.description: Empirical Core Web Vitals, server response times (TTFB), Lighthouse performance audit, and asset size.

security.name: Security
security.description: Static vulnerability scanning (SAST), dependency CVE audits, secret leakage detection, and sanitization.

novelty.name: Innovation/Novelty
novelty.description: Originality of technical approach, differentiation from existing solutions, and verified market novelty.

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.description: Completeness of README, architecture diagrams, local setup instructions, inline comments, and API specs.

engineering_practices.name: Engineering Practices
engineering_practices.description: CI/CD pipeline presence, automated test coverage, environment configuration hygiene, and git commit quality.
